summary: Plutonian Acquisition Corp. II filed an 8-K reporting the effectiveness of its S-1 registration statement and the consummation of its initial public offering on April 29, 2026. The SPAC issued 10,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, each consisting of one Class A ordinary share and one right entitling the holder to receive one-fourth of a share upon a future business combination, raising $100 million gross proceeds. The company entered into an underwriting agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners, a rights agreement, letter agreement with sponsor and insiders, investment management trust agreement, and registration rights agreement. The proceeds are held in trust pending a target acquisition. Key watch items: the 18-24 month deadline to complete a business combination and potential redemption pressures.
